strings.meta.title: pdff — Mekrayn, kɔnvot ɛn edet PDF, Word, Excel fɛri
strings.meta.description: Fɛri onlain tul fɛr fɔ mekrayn, kɔnvot, kɔmpres, splet ɛn protɛkt di PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint ɛn imej fayl dɛn. No sig-ap, dɛn dɛlɛt di fayl dɛn kwikwis.

strings.seo.why[0].title: 100% fɛri
strings.seo.why[0].text: No sabskripshɔn, no kredit kad, no watmak de na yu dakument dɛn.
strings.seo.why[1].title: No sig-ap
strings.seo.why[1].text: No akawnt fɔ mek: opn di pej, drɔp yu fayl dɛn, i dɔn.
strings.seo.why[2].title: Yu fayl dɛn de stil na yu yon
strings.seo.why[2].text: Dɛn de wok na am, dɔn dɛlɛt am wantɛm. Wi no de kip yu dakument o yu deta.
strings.seo.why[3].title: ɔl fɔmat
strings.seo.why[3].text: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, imej dɛn, EPUB… fɔm kɔmpiuta o fon.
strings.seo.faqTitle: Kuestin dɛn we pɔsin kin ask bɔt
strings.seo.faq[0].a: Yes. ɔl tul fɛri, no watmak de ɛn nòtinn de bihond sabskripshɔn. Dɛn no de ask fɔ kredit kad.
strings.seo.faq[1].a: No. No sig-ap, no imel adrɛs: yu de yuz di tul dɛn wantɛm.
strings.seo.faq[2].q: Dɛn de kip mi dakument dɛn?
strings.seo.faq[2].a: No. Dɛn de yuz yu fayl dɛn onli fɔ di wok we yu ask fɔ, dɔn dɛlɛt am. Nɔmbɔdi no de rid am ɛn dɛn no de she am.
strings.seo.faq[3].a: Yes. pdff de ron na di brawza fɔ ɛni fon, tablet o kɔmpiuta (Android, iPhone, Windows, Mac, Linux), nòtinn no de fɔ instɔl.
strings.seo.faq[4].a: PDF, Word (DOCX, DOC), Excel (XLSX, XLS, CSV), PowerPoint (PPTX, PPT), OpenDocument (ODT, ODS, ODP), RTF, imej dɛn (JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF, GIF, SVG), EPUB, TXT, HTML ɛn mɔ.
strings.seo.faq[5].a: Yu ebul wok na {files} fayl dɛn wan tɛm, ɛn di dakument we kɔmɔt ebul gɛt op tu {pages} pej.
strings.privacy.title: Prayvasi
strings.privacy.description: Aw pdff de tek kia fɔ yu fayl dɛn: no akawnt, no dakument de kipa, no ad ɛn no deta sel.
strings.privacy.updated: Tɛm we dɛn chenj am last: {date}
strings.privacy.intro: dɛn mek pdff so dat yu dakument dɛn go stil na yu yon. Dis na wetin de hapin we yu yuz am, in plain tɔk.
strings.privacy.sections[0].title: Yu fayl dɛn
strings.privacy.sections[0].text: Dɛn de sɛnd am ɛnkrip (HTTPS), wok na am awtomatikali, dɔn dɛlɛt am wantɛm we di rizin redi. Big fayl dɛn de go na tɛmpɔri storij na random nem ɛn dɛn de klia am wantɛm we di wok dɔn; awtomatik klia-klia de klia ɛnitin we de lida witin 24 awa.
strings.privacy.sections[1].title: No akawnt, no pɔsɔnal deta
strings.privacy.sections[1].text: pdff no de ask fɔ no sig-ap, no imel adrɛs ɛn no kredit kad. Dɛn no de rid yu dakument dɛn, analiz am, she am o yuz am fɔ tren atifishial intɛlijɛns.
strings.privacy.sections[2].title: Luk aw menli pɔsin de kam
strings.privacy.sections[2].text: Wi de kount visit anɔnimɔsli ɛn witawt kukis (Vercel Web Analytics) fɔ no wɛn tul yusful. No ad, no kros-say trakin.
strings.privacy.sections[3].title: Kukis
strings.privacy.sections[3].text: Wan ɔpshɔnal kuki: i de memba di langwej we yu chuz.
strings.privacy.sections[4].title: Ostin
strings.privacy.sections[4].text: Vercel de ost di sayt na sɛva na Paris; Word, Excel ɛn PowerPoint kɔnvɛshɔn na Render na Frankfurt de tek kia fɔ am. Dis pipul dɛn de tek kia fɔ fayl dɛn onli di tɛm we kɔnvɛshɔn de go on.
strings.privacy.sections[5].title: Kɔntakt
strings.privacy.sections[5].text: Kuestin o kɔmɛnt? Kɔntakt wi fɔm di projɛkt pej:
strings.tools.fusionner.name: Mekrayn
strings.tools.fusionner.tagline: Jɔn bɔku fayl dɛn (PDF, Word, imej dɛn…) fɔ mek wan PDF, na di oDA we yu chuz.

strings.tools.fusionner.seoDescription: Jɔn PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint ɛn imej fayl dɛn fɔ mek wan PDF, na di oda we yu want. Fɛri, no sig-ap, no watmak, dɛlɛt di fayl dɛn wantɛm.
strings.tools.fusionner.intro: Put ɔl yu pepawok na wan fayl: pdff de tek PDF ɛn di wans dɛn lɛk Word dakument, Excel shit, prizɛnteshɔn ɛn foto dɛn, ɛn jɔn am fɔ mek wan klin PDF wit wan bukmak fɔ ɛni fayl.

strings.tools.convertir.intro: Wan kɔnvota fɔ ɛni fɔmat: Word tu PDF, PDF tu Word, JPG tu PDF, PDF tu JPG, Excel tu PDF, PowerPoint tu PDF, PNG tu JPG, EPUB tu PDF… Drɔp yu fayl dɛn ɛn pdff de sho onli di fɔmat dɛn we ebul.

strings.tools.diviser.intro: Sɛnd onli di pat fɔ big dakument we impɔtant: pdff de kot yu PDF na di ren dɛn we yu chuz ɛn gi yu di pis dɛn bak na ZIP akiv.

strings.tools.extraire.seoDescription: Kip onli di pej dɛn we yu nid fɔm PDF, o dɛlɛt di odha wan dɛn. Onlain, fɛri, no sig-ap, no watmak.
strings.tools.extraire.intro: Blang pej, apɛndiks we no yusful, dupulket? Tayp di pej dɛn fɔ kip o dɛlɛt (fɔ ɛgzampul 1-3, 7, 10-end) ɛn gɛt wan klin PDF insay sɛkɔnd.

strings.tools.organiser.intro: Skan pej dɛn we no de na ɔda? Tayp di nyu ɔda (fɔ ɛgzampul 3, 1, 2, 4-end) o rivas di oul dakument: pdff de tek kia fɔ di rɛs.
